newsitem.title: CANADA: Breakwater signs best efforts share issue.
newsitem.headline: Breakwater signs best efforts share issue.

text.p: Breakwater Resources Ltd said on Tuesday that Newcrest Capital Inc has agreed to buy 15 million Breakwater shares for resale to the public.
Newcrest will pay C$32.25 million or C$2.15 per share, Breakwater said in a statement.
To facilitate the issue, Dundee Bancorp Inc, Breakwater's principal shareholder, has agreed to buy 4.65 million of the 15 million common shares.
Newcrest has also agreed to place one million special warrants of Breakwater on a best efforts basis.

The warrant transaction will give Breakwater C$2.35 million or C$2.35 per share. Each special warrant entitles the holder to buy for no additional consideration one flow-through common share of Breakwater.
The proceeds of the issues along with previously arranged debt financing will be used to bring the Caribou and Restigouche mines into production, Breakwater said.
Both mines, located in the Bathurst area of New Brunswick, are expected to start production in mid-1997.
The closing of both issues is scheduled for September 16.
